headline: 'Design Platform Minted Is Exploring A Sale; Minted Working With JP Morgan On Sale That Could Value It At $1B' - Reuters Exclusive
'I Don't Think The CLARITY Act Is Going To Do It': Bitcoin Needs Stronger Tailwinds, Expert Says
summary: Tyrone Ross Jr. believes Bitcoin will need more than the CLARITY Act to regain momentum, arguing that regulatory certainty alone is unlikely to trigger the next bull run. While institutional adoption by firms continues to accelerate, Ross says retail participation remains weak.
